title: GPT-5.5 prompting guide with user-visible updates pattern
description: OpenAI released comprehensive prompting tips for GPT-5.5 API, including a key pattern for multi-step tasks: send short user-visible updates before tool calls to acknowledge requests and state first steps. This makes longer-running tasks feel less like the model has crashed. OpenAI also emphasizes treating GPT-5.5 as a new model family to tune from scratch rather than as a drop-in replacement for gpt-5.2 or gpt-5.4.
author: Simon Willison

title: OpenAI unifies Codex into main GPT model line
description: Romain Huet confirms that since GPT-5.4, OpenAI has unified Codex and the main model into a single system, eliminating the separate coding line. GPT-5.5 extends this with strong gains in agentic coding, computer use, and general computer tasks.
author: Simon Willison (quoting Romain Huet)

title: Andrej Karpathy on 'vibe coding' and feeling behind in AI development
description: Karpathy discussed developing additional tools including 'vibe coding a small and naive search engine over the wiki.' At Sequoia AI Ascent 2026, he noted that after coining 'vibe coding' last year, he now 'never felt more behind as a programmer,' highlighting the rapid pace of AI development leaving even experts feeling overwhelmed.
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: AI advice rapid obsolescence warning
description: A discussion referencing Karpathy's warning that '90% of AI advice dies in 6 months' and noting that 'most tools will not even survive 90 days' in the current fast-moving AI development landscape.
author: DataChaz (referencing Andrej Karpathy)
